# Urban Flood Nowcasting System

> Real-time 0-3 hour street-level flood depth prediction, drainage graph modeling, and flood-safe navigation for the Dwarka Mor catchment, Delhi (SIH 2026).

## Overview
This system combines Doppler weather radar nowcasts, a Digital Elevation Model, and a directed-graph stormwater drainage network model to predict centimeter-level street flooding up to 3 hours in advance, with an API for flood-safe route navigation.

## Key Pages
- [Live Dashboard](https://5d-beings.vercel.app/) - Real-time flood forecast and map
- [API Documentation](https://5d-beings.vercel.app/api/docs) - Swagger/OpenAPI docs
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://5d-beings.vercel.app/api/openapi.json) - Machine-readable API schema

## API Endpoints
- GET /api/nowcast - Live street water depth nowcast
- GET /api/drainage-network - 1D directed drainage graph network
- POST /api/navigate - Flood-safe alternative detour route
- POST /api/alert-broadcast - Emergency flood alert broadcast
- GET /api/v1/potholes-depressions - Verified potholes and road depressions registry
